response.sql: WITH order_item_stats AS (SELECT order_item_id, AVG(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost != 0 THEN derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost ELSE NULL END) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS invoice_line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY order_item_id) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio, AVG(invoice_line_item_count) AS avg_invoice_line_items_per_order_item FROM order_item_stats
